whyTheyDiffer.summary: The authorization string hashed a non-committed assemble-time manifest file. The commit that landed on HEAD wrote a different whole-file serialization of option-d-replay-manifest.json. Whole-file SHA-256 includes generatedAt and the full JSON document; it is not equal to per-entry assembledSha256 verification, Git blob OID, or a later re-assemble output.
ruledOut: Not the Git blob OID (SHA-1 d14c56dc289062df6376266a5424beaa12d7f641)
Not recoverable as generatedAt-only mutation of the committed bytes within +/- 1 hour of committed generatedAt
Not SHA-256 of sibling remediation JSON artifacts at the same commit (dependency-manifest, ordering-changelog, replay-gate, procedural audit, unresolved classification, overrides)
whyTheyDiffer.processDefect: Runtime proceeded after observing authorization SHA-256 != committed content SHA-256, treating zero entry-hash failures as sufficient. That override is forbidden.
